newsitem.title: USA: HyperDynamics Q2 Dec 31 net loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: HyperDynamics Q2 Dec 31 net loss vs profit.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Net loss for the second quarter of 1996 included a tax benefit of $50,616.
Net loss from continuing operations for the second quarter of 1996 was $118,513, or $0.01 per share, as compared to a net loss for the second quarter of 1995 of $15,733.
Net loss from continuing operations for the first six months of 1996 was $201,963, or $0.03 per share, as compared to net loss for the first six months of 1995 of $30,913.
The company did not report earnings per share for 1995 because it only came into existence as a corporation in August 1996.
